--- Table 1: adventureworks.production.workorder ---
Domain: Manufacturing
Description: Manufacturing work orders.
Fields:
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Reference to the product being manufactured in this work order
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The date when the work order record was last updated
  - workorderid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for the manufacturing work order
  - scrapreasonid (smallint(16,0)) [FK]: Reference to the categorized reason explaining why units were scrapped during production
  - orderqty (integer(32,0)): The planned quantity of products to be produced in this work order
  - duedate (timestamp without time zone): The target completion date by which the work order should be finished
  - enddate (timestamp without time zone): The date when production of the work order was completed
  - startdate (timestamp without time zone): The scheduled or actual date when production of the work order begins
  - scrappedqty (smallint(16,0)): The number of units scrapped or discarded during production due to defects or errors
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 2: adventureworks.purchasing.purchaseorderdetail ---
Domain: Procurement
Description: Individual products associated with a specific purchase order. See PurchaseOrderHeader.
Fields:
  - receivedqty (numeric(8,2)): The quantity of units actually received into inventory from the vendor
  - unitprice (numeric): The negotiated price per unit charged by the vendor for this product
  - purchaseorderid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: Foreign key referencing the parent purchase order header that groups this line item
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The timestamp when this purchase order detail record was last updated
  - duedate (timestamp without time zone): The expected or scheduled date by which the ordered goods should be delivered
  - rejectedqty (numeric(8,2)): The quantity of received units rejected due to quality or specification issues
  - productid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key to the product being ordered from the catalog
  - purchaseorderdetailid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique surrogate key identifying each line item within a purchase order
  - orderqty (smallint(16,0)): The quantity of product units requested from the vendor
Match reason: Source: vector

--- Table 3: adventureworks.production.transactionhistory ---
Domain: Inventory
Description: Record of each purchase order, sales order, or work order transaction year to date.
Fields:
  - transactiontype (character(1)): Single-character code indicating the type of transaction (e.g., P for Purchase, S for Sales, W for Work Order)
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp when the transaction record was last updated or modified in the system
  - quantity (integer(32,0)): Number of units involved in the transaction for the associated product
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [FK]: Unique identifier referencing the product being transacted in this record
  - transactionid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Primary key and unique identifier for each individual transaction record
  - referenceorderid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key linking to the parent order (purchase, sales, or work order) that initiated this transaction
  - transactiondate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when the actual transaction occurred in the business process
  - actualcost (numeric): Real monetary cost incurred for the transaction, used for financial reporting and cost analysis
  - referenceorderlineid (integer(32,0)): Foreign key referencing the specific line item within the parent order, allowing granular transaction tracking

  - documentnode (character varying) [PK]: Hierarchical identifier referencing the specific document in the document repository, indicating its location in the document structure
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp recording when the product-document association was last updated, used for audit trails and data synchronization processes

--- Table 6: adventureworks.purchasing.productvendor ---
Domain: Purchasing
Description: Cross-reference table mapping vendors with the products they supply.
Fields:
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier linking to the product being sourced from this vendor
  - minorderqty (integer(32,0)): Minimum quantity that must be ordered from this vendor per purchase order
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: Vendor (supplier) identifier from the business entity master
  - maxorderqty (integer(32,0)): Maximum quantity allowed per purchase order from this vendor
  - lastreceiptdate (timestamp without time zone): Date when the most recent shipment was received from this vendor
  - lastreceiptcost (numeric): Unit cost paid for the product in the most recent receipt from this vendor
  - unitmeasurecode (character(3)): Standard unit of measure for ordering this product from the vendor (e.g., EACH, CASE)
  - onorderqty (integer(32,0)): Current quantity of this product that has been ordered but not yet received
  - averageleadtime (integer(32,0)): Average number of days between placing an order and receiving the product from this vendor
  - standardprice (numeric): Standard unit price charged by this vendor for the product
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Date and time when this vendor-product relationship record was last updated

--- Table 7: adventureworks.purchasing.vendor ---
Domain: Vendor
Description: Companies from whom Adventure Works Cycles purchases parts or other goods.
Fields:
  - purchasingwebserviceurl (character varying(1024)): Web service endpoint URL used for electronic data interchange and automated purchasing transactions with the vendor
  - name (character varying(50)): Official business name of the vendor or supplier company
  - activeflag (boolean): Indicator of whether the vendor is currently operational and conducting business
  - accountnumber (character varying(15)): Internal accounting code assigned to track and process financial transactions with the vendor
  - businessentityid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier referencing the underlying business entity record for data consistency across the enterprise
  - creditrating (smallint(16,0)): Numerical assessment of the vendor's creditworthiness and financial reliability, typically on a scale where lower values indicate better credit standing
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): Timestamp recording the most recent update to the vendor's master record for audit and synchronization purposes
  - preferredvendorstatus (boolean): Flag designating whether the vendor is approved and prioritized as a preferred supplier for purchasing decisions

--- Table 10: adventureworks.production.workorderrouting ---
Domain: Manufacturing
Description: Work order details.
Fields:
  - actualstartdate (timestamp without time zone): The actual date and time when this routing operation began execution on the production floor
  - scheduledenddate (timestamp without time zone): The planned date and time when this routing operation is expected to be completed
  - scheduledstartdate (timestamp without time zone): The planned date and time when this routing operation is scheduled to begin
  - actualcost (numeric): The total actual cost incurred for performing this specific routing operation, including labor, materials, and overhead
  - actualenddate (timestamp without time zone): The actual date and time when this routing operation was finished
  - workorderid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: The unique identifier of the parent work order that this routing operation belongs to
  - plannedcost (numeric): The estimated or budgeted cost for this routing operation prior to execution
  - locationid (smallint(16,0)) [FK]: The identifier of the work center or physical location where this operation is performed
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: The identifier of the product or item being manufactured through this routing operation
  - actualresourcehrs (numeric(9,4)): The actual number of labor and machine hours consumed during this routing operation
  - operationsequence (smallint(16,0)) [PK]: The numeric order in which this operation appears in the product's routing path, determining the sequence of manufacturing steps
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The timestamp indicating when this routing record was last modified or updated

Domain: Product
Description: Changes in the cost of a product over time.
Fields:
  - enddate (timestamp without time zone): The last date when this cost version was effective; after this date, a new cost superseded this record
  - modifieddate (timestamp without time zone): The date and time when this cost record was last updated or modified in the system
  - standardcost (numeric): The monetary value representing the standard cost of the product during this effective period
  - startdate (timestamp without time zone) [PK]: The first date when this cost version became effective and was used for valuation purposes
  - productid (integer(32,0)) [PK] [FK]: The unique identifier of the product for which this cost history record applies
